displayIdentity.body: The First and the Last speaks of death and life. The message also names suffering, poverty and wealth, blasphemy, and a synagogue. It also names the devil, prison, testing, ten days, faithfulness, a crown, and the second death.
displayIdentity.title: Smyrna hears of Satan’s synagogue. The devil will send some to prison.
